title: AMD Radeon RX 9050: A New Graphics Card with 8GB Memory
description: AMD has announced the Radeon RX 9050 graphics card, featuring 8GB memory and 100W TBP, as reported by VideoCardz.com. This comes as part of AMD's broader release of new drivers and hardware.

sections.heading: AMD Radeon RX 9050 Announcement
paragraphs: AMD has revealed the Radeon RX 9050, a new graphics card that has garnered attention in the Philippines, according to Google Trends data. The announcement has been covered by various tech news outlets, highlighting its specifications and implications for the graphics card market.

sections.heading: Specifications and Features
paragraphs: VideoCardz.com reports that the Radeon RX 9050 comes with 8GB of memory and a 100W total board power (TBP). This marks a return to 4GB graphics cards, as noted by PCWorld, which could be significant for users looking for more affordable options in the graphics card market.

sections.heading: AMD Software Adrenalin 26.7.1 WHQL Drivers
paragraphs: In conjunction with the Radeon RX 9050 announcement, TechPowerUp reports that AMD has also released the AMD Software Adrenalin 26.7.1 WHQL Drivers. These drivers are expected to enhance the performance and compatibility of AMD's graphics cards, including the newly announced Radeon RX 9050.
